title: How many Asian students were enrolled in Okaloosa County schools in 2023-24 school year?
text:
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Manny Diaz,Jr., Commissioner of education at Florida Department of Education | https://www.fldoe.org/about-us/commissioner.stml
Florida Department of Education.
Data showed that Okaloosa County welcomed a total of 32,415 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, Asian students comprised 1.5% of the student body to be the second least represented ethnicity in the county.
Among the 50 schools in Okaloosa County, Fort Walton Beach High School recorded the highest enrollment of Asian students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 47 students, making up 3% of the school's total student body.
Gov. DeSantis has approved an education budget of over $28 billion for the 2024-25 school year. The new budget includes more than $1 billion earmarked exclusively for teacher salaries to better address the teacher shortage the state faces.
A 2024 WalletHub study ranked Florida 49th in the nation for teacher salaries when adjusted for cost of living, making it one of the lowest in the U.S.
